facts.text: Phinda Private Game Reserve is set within the Munywana Conservancy in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
facts.excerpt: Set within the pioneering Munywana Conservancy in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa

facts.text: The reserve is a short drive from the beaches and coral reefs of the Indian Ocean.
facts.excerpt: a short drive from the unspoiled beaches and coral reefs of the Indian Ocean

facts.text: Phinda spans 29,866 hectares (73,800 acres) across seven distinct habitats.
facts.excerpt: Spanning 29,866 hectares (73,800 acres) of rare biodiversity across seven distinct habitats

facts.text: Phinda's seven habitats range from rare sand forest and savanna to wetland and woodland.
facts.excerpt: encompassing seven distinct ecosystems, from rare sand forest and savanna to wetland and woodland

facts.text: Phinda is home to the Big Five, along with cheetah, hyena, giraffe, nyala, zebra and more than 400 bird species.
facts.excerpt: Phinda is home to the Big Five, along with cheetah, hyena, giraffe, nyala, zebra and more than 400 bird species.

facts.text: Phinda limits vehicles, with sightings of cheetah, black rhino, elephant and the shy suni antelope.
facts.excerpt: Seven habitats. Limited vehicles. Exclusive sightings of cheetah, black rhino, elephant and the shy suni antelope.

facts.text: Phinda Private Game Reserve is home to six lodges, each designed to reflect its own setting.
facts.excerpt: Phinda Private Game Reserve is home to six exceptional lodges, each thoughtfully designed to reflect its unique setting.

facts.text: The reserve can be reached via a private airstrip exclusive to andBeyond guests, or by road from Durban, Richards Bay or Johannesburg.
facts.excerpt: The reserve is easily accessed via a private airstrip exclusive to _&Beyond_ guests, or by road from Durban, Richards Bay or Johannesburg.

facts.text: Phinda is located in a low-risk malaria area, and travellers should consult their healthcare provider before travel.
facts.excerpt: Phinda is located in a low-risk malaria area in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. While precautions are generally not required, travellers should consult their healthcare provider before travel.

facts.text: Phinda was andBeyond's first game reserve, created on land that had endured almost a century of pineapple, cattle and sisal farming.
facts.excerpt: having endured almost a century dominated by pineapple, cattle and sisal farms

facts.text: Phinda means 'the return' in Zulu.
facts.excerpt: Phinda means “the return” in Zulu

facts.text: A significant portion of the land has been returned to its ancestral owners in a partnership between andBeyond and the neighbouring Makhasa and Mnqobokazi communities.
facts.excerpt: a significant portion of the land has since been returned to its ancestral owners in a groundbreaking partnership between _&Beyond_ and the neighbouring Makhasa and Mnqobokazi communities

facts.text: Guests can cycle through the rare sand forest on a guided e-bike excursion.
facts.excerpt: Cycle through the rare Sand Forest on this guided excursion

facts.text: Marine encounters at Phinda range from turtle nesting adventures to ocean safaris and scuba diving.
facts.excerpt: From turtle nesting adventures to ocean safaris and scuba diving, _&Beyond_ Phinda offers a host of marine encounters.

facts.text: Phinda offers a boating experience on the Mzinene River.
facts.excerpt: Mzinene River boating experience

facts.text: Guests can join a sleepout under the stars at Phinda.
facts.excerpt: Fall asleep under a velvet African sky at Phinda Private Game Reserve

facts.text: Guests can assist with the research and monitoring of Phinda's endangered species.
facts.excerpt: Be a part of a pioneering conservation story by assisting us in the research and monitoring of our endangered species

facts.text: Phinda offers a variety of walking safaris.
facts.excerpt: Get closer to Africa's wildlife on a variety of walking safaris at Phinda Private Game Reserve

facts.text: Wild Impact community experiences connect guests with Zulu culture.
facts.excerpt: Join Wild Impact community experiences that connect you with Zulu culture

facts.text: Phinda Forest Lodge is set within one of Africa's last remaining dry sand forests.
facts.excerpt: Set within one of Africa’s last remaining dry sand forests, Phinda Forest Lodge

facts.text: Phinda Forest Lodge's Zulu-zen inspired suites are raised on stilts among the trees, with walls of glass.
facts.excerpt: Zulu-zen inspired Suites rise lightly on stilts, woven into the trees rather than placed upon the land. Each one dissolves the boundary between inside and out. Walls of glass open to layered green

facts.text: Phinda Rock Lodge is set into the cliff face above the valley.
facts.excerpt: Set into the cliff face above the valley, Phinda Rock Lodge

facts.text: Phinda Rock Lodge suites are built from contoured stone and open onto a private deck and plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: is constructed from contoured stone, with solid wooden shutters and doors that open onto a private deck and plunge pool

facts.text: Phinda Mountain Lodge is perched on a hilltop with panoramic views and a family-friendly design.
facts.excerpt: Perched high on a hilltop, Phinda Mountain Lodge offers panoramic views and deep solace in the heart of the wild. Thoughtfully designed for connection, it is where intuitive service and spacious family-friendly design

facts.text: Phinda Vlei Lodge sits between rare sand forest and a wildlife-rich wetland.

facts.text: Phinda Vlei suites have a private pool and an open-air shower.
facts.excerpt: Outside, a private pool and open-air shower draw you closer to the rhythm of the reserve.

facts.text: Phinda Zuka can be reserved for exclusive use or booked by the suite.
facts.excerpt: Phinda Zuka can be reserved for exclusive-use up to 10 guests or booked by the suite for more flexible travel.

facts.text: Phinda's leopard habituation began in the Phinda Zuka area.
facts.excerpt: This is also where Phinda’s leopard habituation began.

facts.text: Phinda Homestead is a private safari home where each stay is looked after by a dedicated ranger, tracker, butler, chef and host.
facts.excerpt: Every day moves at your own pace, held by a dedicated ranger, tracker, butler, chef and host.

facts.text: Phinda is described as one of the best places in South Africa to see black rhino and pangolin.
facts.excerpt: It's also one of the best places in South Africa to see rare species like black rhino and pangolin.
